places.name: Stream wheat seedling
places.note: My first wheat crop by the stream; growing at 43% when last checked.
places.author: Gary

places.name: Stream wheat patch
places.note: Four crops beside flowing water; seedling 14%, next 29%, third 43%.
places.author: Gary

places.name: North stream surface scout
places.note: Open grassy bank west of the water; no exposed clay found on first look.
places.author: Gary

places.name: Birch hillside surface exit
places.note: Surface opening above the vertical shaft; avoid entering the shaft. A cobblestone step is visible here.
places.author: Gary

places.name: Birch flower meadow
places.note: Open grassy hollow among birch trees with pink tulips and purple flowers.
places.author: Gary

places.name: West flower slope shelf
places.note: Open surface shelf above the shallow stone pocket; from the pocket a diagonal route here came out safely.
places.author: Gary

places.name: Gary's cabin chest
places.note: Birch chest inside cabin, in the northwest corner. Gary's working supplies.
places.author: Gary

places.name: North ridge surface zinc
places.note: Exposed sundries:zinc_ore in a gravel and stone clearing. Nearby cave mobs, stay on the surface.
places.author: Gary

places.name: East birch chicken clearing
places.note: Saw a free-range chicken here. Look for eggs and more chickens to breed.
places.author: Gary

places.name: South ridge above the stone tower
places.note: Grassy ridge east of the developed shore. Return to cabin through the upper meadow.
places.author: Gary

places.name: South grassy coast overlook
places.note: Steep vegetated bank above open water. Approach through the ridge and keep off the edge.
places.author: Gary

places.name: Coal seam from spesk01
places.note: spesk01 reported a big coal deposit and earlier invited me to mine it. Prior body mining attempt did not yield coal; verify access from the surface.
places.author: Gary

places.name: West bank chicken overlook
places.note: Dry spot outside the east fence. All three birds were visible together in the south section from here.
places.author: Gary

places.name: Spesk's jungle bridge
places.note: Spesk01 says this bridge crosses a small sea to a jungle. Verify approach on foot; preserve his builds.
places.author: Gary

places.name: West bank pasture site
places.note: Open grass and podzol bench west of the chicken pen. The south rim crossing remains east of the proposed fence.
places.author: Gary

places.name: Far northwest berry thicket
places.note: Seven sweet berry bushes below the red mushrooms at the dark oak edge. Skeletons remain active under the canopy by day. Use a lit approach from the southeast or accessible outer edge.
places.author: Gary

places.name: West stream pig pen clearing
places.note: Candidate flat dirt shelf between the north pig slope and cabin. Check rising ground on the northwest edge when fencing.
places.author: Gary

places.name: Pig trail northwest ridge turn
places.note: Dry ridge south of the upper birch pigs. Return southeast below the crest toward the west stream pen.
places.author: Gary

places.name: South pasture birch grove
places.note: Open birch slope south of the pasture and coop. Harvest away from the trail and replant saplings in the clearings.
places.author: Gary

places.name: Shore shelter north porch
places.note: Natural shelf just south of the trail from the terrace bypass to the gold stair. New shelter door faces north from this porch.
places.author: Gary

places.name: Shore kelp landing
places.note: Two dry birch boards extending west from bucket shelf. Start the kelp nursery on the south side in two-deep water.
places.author: Gary

places.name: West coast water ledge
places.note: Narrow shoreline at sea level beside a steep stone wall. Approach by the inland switchback or stay above at West coast stone brow.
places.author: Gary

places.name: West coast spider slope
places.note: Rain-death spot on the open grass and stone spine. Avoid at night. Dry inland approach from the pasture traverse.
places.author: Gary

places.name: West coast stone chute
places.note: Dry stone switchback below the stone brow. Go through the cut corner above this ledge and keep north of the cliff edge.
places.author: Gary

places.name: West stone stair middle landing
places.note: Two flat blocks in the west coast stair. Follow the same line up to daylight or down to the shore passage.
places.author: Gary

places.name: West stone stair lower turn
places.note: Turn south here instead of digging deeper. Water begins just below this clay and stone shelf.
places.author: Gary

places.name: West cliff sea window
places.note: Dry tunnel mouth two blocks above the west ocean. Daylight reaches it from the sea side. Keep to the stone landing.
places.author: Gary

places.name: Stream rail hillside bend
places.note: Spesk01's powered hill bend. I restored coarse dirt and powered rails and verified the connected run. Keep walking waypoints on the field bank north of the line.
places.author: Gary

places.name: Shore workshop south work shelf
places.note: Grassy slope behind the birch shelter's south window. Approach around the east corner by the higher grass to avoid the low west shore.
places.author: Gary

places.name: Shore workshop generator service stone
places.note: Stand on the east stone lip to reach the one-block generator jacket. Approach from the higher east grass; cap it before leaving after servicing.
places.author: Gary

places.name: Shore workshop generator grass approach
places.note: Reach the dry bay by rounding the east corner of the shelter on the higher grass. Stay clear of the steep low west bank.
places.author: Gary

places.name: Birch quarry aircraft stance
places.note: Clear dry natural stone in the quarry bowl. Climb vertically within the opening before crossing the canopy.
places.author: Gary

places.name: Zinc shelf aircraft stance
places.note: Dry natural ledge off the meadow path. The vertical opening is over this stance. Keep clear of birches to the northeast.
places.author: Gary

places.name: Pasture stray cow last seen
places.note: Cow temporarily loose on the southwest grass after shearing. It followed wheat to the top steps. Both south gates are closed while I get a lead.
places.author: Gary

places.name: West slope buried amethyst shell
places.note: Budding amethyst and mature clusters seen by block search. Buried under the western hillside. Access was not known at this survey.
places.author: Gary

places.name: West amethyst prospect elbow
places.note: Lit turn at the end of the north-running cut. Return south along the narrow stair toward the west coast.
places.author: Gary

places.name: West amethyst prospect lower light
places.note: Dry lit end of the exploratory stair. The geode is ahead and east behind stone. Stay on the lit cut.
places.author: Gary

places.name: West amethyst prospect upper bend
places.note: First step down toward the geode prospect. The tread immediately north is one block lower. Return south to the sea stair.
places.author: Gary

places.name: North ridge hay and lantern
places.note: Small birch hillside clearing with hay bales, lantern and a Lootr barrel. Use the grass from the south and mind the north slope.
places.author: Gary

places.name: North ridge lilac gravel shelf
places.note: Lit gravel apron with lilacs on the north descent from the hay clearing. Follow the trunk-free grass northeast.
places.author: Gary

places.name: North mushroom spring approach
places.note: Dry grass south of a natural mushroom spring and Lootr chest. A creeper hid in rain under the leaves. Approach in light with food and shield ready.
places.author: Gary

places.name: West sea stair amethyst shell
places.note: Buried geode inside protected world spawn. Leave the shell and buds intact. The outside prospect ends to its west.
places.author: Gary

places.name: Shore amethyst branch mouth
places.note: Opposite the redstone branch, go west into the narrow natural-stone cut. Leave the main diamond stair floor clear.
places.author: Gary

places.name: Shore amethyst coal turn
places.note: Follow the torch west from the mouth, then turn north here. The water pocket lies to the southwest behind solid rock.
places.author: Gary

places.name: Shore amethyst deepslate descent
places.note: Turn west at the north end of the level bore. Follow the lit short treads to the next marked turn.
places.author: Gary

places.name: Shore amethyst last turn
places.note: At the lower light turn north two treads, then west into basalt and calcite. Use short exact-height legs on the return.
places.author: Gary

places.name: Shore amethyst shell light
places.note: Torched east approach to the first geode window. Budding blocks ahead at several heights. Preserve them and keep the shelf solid.
places.author: Gary

places.name: Signed East workshop pickup chest
places.note: Stand one block south in the aisle, facing north. The birch chest is directly above signed cobble, east of the blue Grid. Margo and I used slot 26 for our trade.
places.author: Gary

places.name: North birch gravel flats
places.note: Broad high birch flats with gravel, blue flowers and wild cattle. Walk south toward the mushroom spring upper return if retracing.
places.author: Gary

places.name: Far north birch descent shoulder
places.note: Gravel shoulder above a northwestern birch descent. Good dry return toward the high gravel flats.
places.author: Gary

places.name: Gary cabin finds barrel
places.note: Signed personal trade and rare finds barrel between pantry and bed. Emeralds and fleet finds here.
places.author: Gary

places.name: Nether south prospect bore first light
places.note: New dry branch leaves the glowstone bore to the south, level with its long run. First light is inside the natural rock. Keep Margo’s original tunnel and torches.
places.author: Gary

places.name: Nether south bore east turn
places.note: Side bore reaches a high drop south. Use the east turn from inside the rock and keep behind the endstop, with torches on the return.
places.author: Gary

places.name: Nether southeast warped saddle
places.note: Dry warped nylium behind the east wall of the south prospect bore. A torch marks the bore treads west. Check the ground under the warped stems before taking the southeast ridge.
places.author: Gary

places.name: Nether southeast cliff shoulder
places.note: Dry shelf east of the warped saddle. Open cliff to the north and a solid netherrack wall to the south; stay inside and use short legs.
places.author: Gary

places.name: Nether southeast drop turn
places.note: Torch on dry cliff footing. East and south are exposed above a lava sea. A descent should stay inside the netherrack to the west.
places.author: Gary

places.name: North birch village aircraft grass
places.note: Level grass just south of the generated village rooftops. Gary touched down vertically here at full health. Keep aircraft off the gravel lanes.
places.author: Gary

places.name: Nether wart shelf underhang
places.note: Dry cave under the higher patch. The walk here from the south bore stopped eleven blocks below the plants.
places.author: Gary

places.name: Nether wart shelf stair top
places.note: Upper turn at the new stair. Walk southeast across dry netherrack to the torch at the wart shelf.
places.author: Gary

places.name: Nether wart shelf stair lower bend
places.note: Lower bend between the underhang torch and the wart shelf turn. Walk-only ascent worked at full health.
places.author: Gary

places.name: Nether warped lower lava shelf
places.note: Natural dry foot below the glowstone bore height. The low east ledge ends over lava. Endermen have reached the open approach.
places.author: Gary

places.name: Nether low east bore first light
places.note: Lower dry cut through the east warped cliff on the lava shore. West is the lower warped shelf. East is the active scouting branch.
places.author: Gary

places.name: Nether low east bore second light
places.note: Covered east tunnel at the second floor torch. West reaches the dry lower shelf.
places.author: Gary

places.name: Nether low east bore rim step
places.note: At the open end of the low east bore. Steep unrailed rim above lava. Return west to the lit corridor.
places.author: Gary

places.name: Nether low east bore south turn
places.note: Cut south from the second light, still at lower rim height. Walk north and west to leave.
places.author: Gary

places.name: Nether low bore bridge junction
places.note: Narrow temporary cobble over lava. North leads to the low bore; southeast is the paired cage scout line. Walk slowly and keep hostile mobs away.
places.author: Gary

places.name: Nether pagoda bridge sightline
places.note: Unrailed single-width cobble over lava. Two cages are inside the warped-roof structure southeast. This position is just outside their activation range.
places.author: Gary

places.name: Nether pagoda approach
places.note: Temporary cobble close enough to activate both cages. Warped-roof pagoda southeast, with dry brown island below. The narrow return bridge is northwest.
places.author: Gary

places.name: Nether pagoda roof bridge step
places.note: From the cobble approach climb one step onto warped roof stair. This is a roof survey route, with unrailed lava bridge behind.
places.author: Gary

places.name: Shore middle stair coal spur
places.note: Deep end of lit iron branch west off the diamond stair. Return uphill past the upper torch. Coal remains in the walls.
places.author: Gary

places.name: Shore deep gold cutting
places.note: A deep natural lens reached by prospecting northeast from the middle stair coal spur. Sixteen raw gold taken; ore remains. Return up the narrow treads before bringing others.
places.author: Gary

places.name: Shore middle stair iron branch mouth
places.author: Gary
places.note: At the middle diamond stair west wall, enter the natural iron branch between the torches. Return from coal and gold may require excavation. Leave the main stair intact.
